'''Cafian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He monitored the Lower [[Promenade]] from his base there, and would gladly help out any fellow [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|trooper]] who happened by.
